name: Umeme Limited
source: Umeme Limited audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, published by the issuer (extract from the audited accounts audited by Ernst & Young Certified Public Accountants of Uganda, clean opinion, approved by the Board 13 June 2025)
unit: UGX, absolute. The issuer prints in Ushs million; every value here is the printed figure multiplied by 1,000,000. Operating Expenses is the printed Repair and maintenance expenses plus Administration expenses plus Increase in expected credit losses less Net foreign exchange gains plus Amortisation, impairment and write off of intangible assets, which is what makes Gross Profit less Operating Expenses equal the printed Operating (loss)/profit. Net Finance Costs is the printed Finance costs less Finance income. Income Tax is the printed Income tax credit/(charge) with its printed sign, so Profit Before Tax plus Income Tax equals the printed (Loss)/profit for the year. Earnings per share is printed in Ushs, not millions.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFrom: Repair and maintenance expenses + Administration expenses + Increase in expected credit losses - Net foreign exchange gains + Amortisation, impairment and write off of intangible assets (printed lines)

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.derivedFrom: Finance costs less Finance income (printed lines)
